title: 艾希·雪日浆果篮
description: 白发艾希穿蓝白保暖斗篷，在木凳上给浆果篮盖布，冰弓静靠架边。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Ashe is an adult Freljordian archer with long white hair, clear blue eyes, a blue hooded cloak, and distinctive pale icy ornamentation. Give her a warm fully covering blue-and-ivory tunic, opaque leggings, gloves, and sturdy boots. Her recognizable large crystalline bow is unstrung in appearance or simply held inactive on a secure wall support, never aimed.
art_direction.scene: She sits on a snow-dusted cabin bench and tucks a checked cloth over a basket of bright berries. One mittened hand steadies the basket while the other folds the corner neatly. A small pine and a closed cabin door form the background, and the bow remains motionless along the wall in a cozy winter pause.
art_direction.palette: icy blue, snow cream, berry red, soft pine green
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
